title: Foundation Models for visual generation (Generative AI)
reading: The slide traces recent foundation models for visual/video generation along a timeline, naming Meta's Emu Video (2023), OpenAI's Sora (2024), and Google's Veo 2 (2025), each illustrated by a sample generated frame. A caption at the bottom quotes the Sora technical report's claim about scaling video generation, with a link to OpenAI's page on video generation models as world simulators.

visuals.description: Horizontal arrow timeline with three tick marks labelled by company logos: Meta / Emu Video 2023, OpenAI / Sora 2024, Google / Veo 2, 2025; right end labelled 'Timeline'. Below each tick is a sample generated image: an emu in ski goggles in snow, an astronaut in a red knit helmet, and a beekeeper among sunflowers and hives.
visuals.assertion: Video generation foundation models have advanced rapidly and in visual fidelity from 2023 to 2025 across major labs.

concepts.name: Foundation models for visual generation
concepts.why_it_matters: Large-scale generative models are the current paradigm for image/video synthesis.

concepts.name: Video generation models as world simulators
concepts.why_it_matters: Framing scaling video generation as a route to general-purpose physical-world simulators.

verbatim_spans: SORA: Scaling video generation model is a promising path towards building general purpose simulators of the physical world
